2014_spells.cause-fear.description: You target one creature you can see within range. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the spell ends. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
2014_spells.cause-fear.effectSummary: Make a target frightened until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.cause-fear.fullDescription: Using 1 action, the frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or become frightened of you until the spell ends; You target one creature you can see within range; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st; The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or become frightened of you until the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
